---
title: "Image credits"
---

Until the saga has its own AI-generated art, many entries use **freely licensed images from Wikipedia and Wikimedia Commons** as stand-ins: period seals, manuscript miniatures, historical paintings, heraldry and photographs of the real places. Each credit below links to the Commons file page, which carries the full author and licence details. Entries without a credit here (e.g. Vytautas, Jogaila, Birutė, Perkūnas, Trakai, the Pebble, the book covers) use the saga's own AI-generated art.

Fetched with `scripts/fetch_wiki_images.py` (mapping in `scripts/wiki_image_map.json`); only Public domain, CC0, CC BY and CC BY-SA files are accepted. Pictures are downscaled copies.

**74 credited images.**
